init.title: ShelfWatch options
init.description: Configure due-date evaluation, OPAC updates, and the optional reading-progress list. Enable keeping completed media to retain returned items in the list.

data_description.due_soon_days: Determines how many days before the due date a checkout is counted as due soon. The default is 7 days.
data_description.update_interval_hours: Determines how often ShelfWatch retrieves current checkouts from the OPAC. Due-date sensors are also recalculated shortly after the local day changes.

data.keep_completed_items: Keep completed media in the Todo list

data_description.enable_todo_list: Creates a Home Assistant Todo list containing all media currently checked out. Items can be checked off manually when they have been read or watched.
data_description.complete_returned_items: Automatically marks an item as completed when it no longer appears among the current OPAC checkouts. Requires the reading progress Todo list.
data_description.keep_completed_items: Keeps completed and returned items visible as a reading history. When disabled, returned items are removed from the list. Requires automatic completion of returned media.
